conclusion: For these two cases, merging adjacent source text into one context-rich evidence unit removed the same binding error that thinking=true also removed, at roughly 1/4 the latency of thinking=true and with no extra prompt-engineering. This points at evidence-pack construction (how atomic units are split) as a more actionable lever than model-side fixes for this failure class. Not yet implemented in src/v3/product_free_rag.py; scoped as future work.
